object.name: evi.plateverb~
object.digest: Plate reverb based on <o>yafr2</o> with additional filtering and smoothing
object.description: Based on <o>yafr2</o> from MSP ('Plate reverb in the style of Griesinger' by Randy Jones). This version for evieve with dry/wet and eq added, as well as modifications for better filtering, interpolation and smoothing, and zero hold delay changes. Parameters normalised 0..1. Clickless and smooth changes possible for all parameters.
object.discussion: For more information about other reverbs in evieve, see the 'evieve reverb' tab of the helpfile.

inlets.digest: Audio In Mono or Left or 1 / messages to evi.plateverb~
inlets.description: Audio In Mono or Left or channel 1, depending on 'stereo' attribute

inlets.digest: Audio In Nothing or Right or 2 / messages to evi.plateverb~
inlets.description: Audio In Nothing or Right or channel 2, depending on 'stereo' attribute

messages.name: pattrstorage
messages.digest: In left inlet, pattrstorage messages to evi.plateverb~
messages.description: Prepending the word 'pattrstorage' allows you to send any message pattrstorage understands to the internal pattrstorage object - you can recieve pattrstorage output via the far right outlet.

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.description: Smooth bypass the reverb (1). Bypassing also CPU-mutes the internal DSP.

attributes.name: damp
attributes.description: Low..high frequency of onepole damping filter on input.

attributes.name: decay
attributes.description: One of the original parameters. Length of reverb late reflections decay. Higher values give a longer decay.

attributes.name: diffuse
attributes.description: One of the original parameters. Amount of diffuseness in the reflections. Affects delay times of multiple embedded delay lines.

attributes.name: dry
attributes.description: There is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This dry gain controls the amount of gain applied to the unprocessed audio in the final mix.

attributes.name: highfrequency
attributes.description: High frequency point in Hz of the end of wet chain onepole shelving filters.

attributes.name: highgain
attributes.description: ± gain of the high shelving onepole filters. Negative values attenuate, positive values boost. -1..1 equates to approximately -10..10 dB.

attributes.name: lowfrequency
attributes.description: Low frequency point in Hz of the end of wet chain onepole shelving filters.

attributes.name: lowgain
attributes.description: ± gain of the low shelving onepole filters. Negative values attenuate, positive values boost. -1..1 equates to approximately -10..10 dB.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: One of the original parameters. The perceived size of the reverb.

attributes.name: smoothtime
attributes.description: Set the smoothing time in ms of all the internal parameter smoothing functions.

attributes.name: stereo
attributes.description: This affects the audio inputs of the reverb (output is always stereo), notably the internal summing of the two inputs. 0=mono in (with pan control), 1=stereo in, 2=two separate channels in.

attributes.name: wet
attributes.description: There is no 'dry/wet' in this reverb. Instead we have separate dry and wet gains. This wet gain controls the amount of gain applied to the processed reverberation (late reflections) in the final mix.
